title: Physically Qualified Imagination II: Stable-Base Composition
research_question: Can invariant-base composition turn generated unilateral and bilateral hand-raising intent into solver-accepted G1 behavior without retraining or weakening the physical safety gate?
robustness_condition: Seeded 0.95 to 1.05 multiplicative stiffness and damping calibration at difficulty band 1.
primary_endpoint: Qualified success requires every requested shoulder to cross -0.15 rad and realize at least 0.25 rad of negative-pitch excursion from its accepted initial state, zero terminations, zero failed environment steps, minimum root height above 0.64 m, and maximum tilt below 0.50 rad.
amendment: Version 2 was frozen after a dry endpoint audit found that an absolute angle alone can count a clip that begins raised. The final study uses five untouched seeds and requires realized excursion; version 1 is not used for paper claims.
composition: Root, legs, waist, and unrequested arm remain at the fixed standing reference. Requested arms preserve the normalized ARDY within-arm trajectory, use unilateral proposals for bilateral composition, and are uniformly scaled only to satisfy compiled position and velocity limits.
claim_gates: all 30 task-method-seed cells complete from a clean numisolver revision
raw state traces and exact commands retained
simulator evidence is not hardware evidence
